question: Is the cumulant distance, and its irreducible-set repair, steps apart on every knot tree of six knots under every law assignment and on random seven-knot trees with at most three knots per distinction?

definitions.delta: min over S containing x, y of (|S|-2) + max(0, -log3|kappa_S|)
definitions.delta_K: the same over irreducible S (kappa_S != 0, kappa_T = 0 for {x,y} <= T < S)

forbidden_inputs: Changing cases, readings, predictions or decision rules after seeing registered results
cheapest_meaningful_control: checks.py: agreement with the earlier delta, brute-force irreducible search, the hub identity and threshold.

predictions.P1: six knots, every assignment: delta = steps

decision_rules.each prediction: holds or fails as scored by merge.py

stop_rule: One run; read-out; proofs; referee hand-off; report.
